slurm.name: job
slurm.launcher_cmd:
export LOCAL_ADDR=$(nslookup $(hostname) | grep "Address: " | sed "s/Address: //" | tail) ;\
 apptainer exec --env PYTHONPATH=.:submodules/Megatron-LM \
 --env RUN_DIR=./submodules/Megatron-LM \
 --env PROJECT_DIR=. \
 --env HF_HOME=/e/project1/jureap59/poeppel1/cache \
 --env TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false \
 --env TRANSFORMERS_CACHE=/e/project1/jureap59/poeppel1/cache/transformers \
 --env HUGGINGFACE_HUB_CACHE=/e/project1/jureap59/poeppel1/cache/hub \
 --env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
 --env TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1 \
 --env PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
 --writable-tmpfs --nv --bind /e \
 --bind /dev/shm \
 /e/project1/e-sta-openeurollm/container/MegatronTraining-JUPITER-linattn_aarch64_202607290923.sif \

env.MASTER_ADDR: $(nslookup $(scontrol show hostnames "$SLURM_JOB_NODELIST" | head -n 1) | grep "Address: " | sed "s/Address: //" | tail)

slurm.name: job
slurm.launcher_cmd:

 apptainer exec --env PYTHONPATH=.:submodules/Megatron-LM \
 --env RUN_DIR=./submodules/Megatron-LM \
 --env PROJECT_DIR=. \
 --env HF_HOME=/e/project1/jureap59/poeppel1/cache \
 --env TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false \

 --env HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 \
 --env TORCHDYNAMO_DISABLE=1 \
 --env PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True \
 --writable-tmpfs --nv --bind /e \
 --bind /dev/shm \
 /e/project1/e-sta-openeurollm/container/MegatronTraining-JUPITER-linattn_aarch64_202607290923.sif \

env.MASTER_ADDR: $(nslookup $(scontrol show hostnames "$SLURM_JOB_NODELIST" | head -n 1) | grep "Address: " | sed "s/Address: //" | tail)

backend.full_cmd:
torchrun \
  --nproc-per-node 4\
  --nnodes 2\
  --max-restarts 0\
  --tee 3\
  --rdzv-endpoint $MASTER_ADDR:$MASTER_PORT\
  --rdzv-backend static\
  --node-rank $SLURM_NODEID\
  --master-addr $MASTER_ADDR\
  --master-port $MASTER_PORT\
  --local-addr $LOCAL_ADDR\
   ./submodules/Megatron-LM/pretrain_gpt.py \
   --accumulate-allreduce-grads-in-fp32\
   --adam-beta2 0.95\
   --disable-bias-linear\
   --attention-backend unfused\
   --attention-dropout 0.0\
   --bf16\
   --no-create-attention-mask-in-dataloader\
   --data-cache-path .cache/multiling_1tt_262k\
   --dataloader-type cyclic\
   --distributed-timeout-minutes 60\
   --eval-interval 1000\
   --eval-iters 0\
   --experimental-attention-variant mlstm\
   --expert-tensor-parallel-size 1\
   --ffn-hidden-size 320\
   --global-batch-size 8\
   --no-gradient-accumulation-fusion\
   --hidden-dropout 0.0\
   --hidden-size 128\
   --kv-channels 128\
   --linear-attention-freq 6\
   --linear-key-head-dim 16\
   --linear-num-key-heads 4\
   --linear-num-value-heads 4\
   --linear-value-head-dim 32\
   --load /e/scratch/projectnucleus/poeppel1/output/architecture_scaling_variants_multilingual/jupiter_smoke_mlstm5_tiny_2n_nvrxfix\
   --log-interval 10\
   --log-progress\
   --log-throughput\
   --log-timers-to-tensorboard\
   --lr 0.002\
   --lr-decay-style WSD\
   --lr-warmup-iters 2\
   --lr-wsd-decay-iters 0\
   --lr-wsd-decay-style linear\
   --make-vocab-size-divisible-by 1\
   --no-masked-softmax-fusion\
   --max-position-embeddings 512\
   --micro-batch-size 1\
   --mock-data\
   --moe-aux-loss-coeff 0.0\
   --moe-router-load-balancing-type aux_loss\
   --normalization RMSNorm\
   --num-attention-heads 4\
   --num-layers 4\
   --num-query-groups 4\
   --num-workers 0\
   --no-overlap-p2p-communication\
   --position-embedding-type rope\
   --qk-layernorm\
   --rerun-mode disabled\
   --save-interval 64000\
   --seq-length 512\
   --swiglu\
   --tensorboard-dir /e/scratch/projectnucleus/poeppel1/output/architecture_scaling_variants_multilingual/jupiter_smoke_mlstm5_tiny_2n_nvrxfix/tensorboard\
   --tokenizer-type NullTokenizer\
   --train-iters 10\
   --trust-remote-code\
   --vocab-size 4096\
   --wandb-entity openeurollm-project\
   --wandb-exp-name jupiter_smoke_mlstm5_tiny_2n_nvrxfix\
   --wandb-project dense_multilingual_scaling_mlstm\
   --wandb-save-dir /e/scratch/projectnucleus/poeppel1/output/architecture_scaling_variants_multilingual/jupiter_smoke_mlstm5_tiny_2n_nvrxfix/wandb\
   --weight-decay 0.1
